# STIX Two Math

The STIX Two Math face from STIX Fonts 2.13 b171 (https://github.com/stipub/stixfonts, tag `v2.13b171`, `fonts/static_otf/STIXTwoMath-Regular.otf`), unmodified. SHA-256:

- `STIXTwoMath-Regular.otf`: `3a5f3f26f40d5698b3c62dd085d48d6663696a3f80825aab8b553d5097518e8c`

Licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 (`OFL.txt`); authors in `AUTHORS.txt`.

Krystal.Booey embeds it as its math font (`codegen/bundled_fonts.py`), found by `font-family: math` through the list of known math fonts.
